# Naviamp 2.11.2

Naviamp 2.11.2 fixes white bands at the top and bottom of the Android app. App backgrounds and filled Now Playing artwork now extend behind the system bars while controls remain safely inset.

## Highlights

- Restore full-window backgrounds on Android.

## Bug fixes

- Remove white status-bar and navigation-bar bands on Android, including filled Now Playing artwork, while keeping controls clear of system bars and the keyboard. ([Issue #598](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/598), [original implementation PR #597](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/597))

## Upgrade notes

- No special upgrade steps are required.
- Store and beta channel versions may differ from GitHub.

## Known issues

- No new known issues. Existing playback, presentation, performance, and platform acceptance investigations continue.
